name: @workspace/tool-logic-svg-to-css
description: The SVG to CSS tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/svg-to-css.md): the check of an SVG by the XML parser of a Document passed in, the safe cleanup, the missing namespaces, the minimal percent-encoding and Base64 of a data: URI, the CSS forms, the notes and the detection. Pure TypeScript: no React, no chrome; the DOM only through a parameter.
